
Here are some suggested names of common chemicals, along with the formal names:

bakrygapci: tabno relkijno (I propose extending ''bakri'' to carbonates in general; for calcium compounds in general we already have ''bongu''.)

bakryslami: tabycibykijyslami

mantygapci: tabno pavykijno (formic acid anhydride)

mantyslami: tabrelkijyslami, pavrasyslami (formic acid, which is the first fatty acid, and carbonic acid straddle the organic acid/inorganic acid boundary)

sarvanslami: relrasyslami

matnyslami: vonrasyslami (to zo mantyslami na.ei fi'urmi'u zo matnyslami toi)

fomsodna: sodnyjoidro bakri
